name: Layout Builder Awesome Sections
description: adds configurable sections to Layout Builder for building page structure.
project_description:
Add some awesome sections which has many useful configuration which let you build site structure with no custom code 
 
 This Module alter core's one column section and add another 4 sections: 
 
 Core One column: 
 Awesome Two column 
 Awesome Three column 
 Awesome Four column 
 Awesome Five column 
 
 
 
 Features 
 These sections can set section class, each region class, each region width, Mobile breakpoint, each region background color, padding, and so on.
